from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer, BitsAndBytesConfig, TextIteratorStreamer

# Persist HF Hub cache on the mounted bucket storage so the 67GB model
# only downloads once and stays cached between ZeroGPU calls.
os.environ.setdefault("HF_HOME", "/data/hf_home")
os.environ.setdefault("HF_HUB_CACHE", "/data/hf_cache")

MODEL_ID = "FINAL-Bench/Darwin-35B-A3B-Opus"
HF_TOKEN = os.environ.get("HF_TOKEN")

BNB = BitsAndBytesConfig(
    load_in_4bit=True,
    bnb_4bit_quant_type="nf4",
    bnb_4bit_use_double_quant=True,
    bnb_4bit_compute_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
    # Allow accelerate to place buffers on CPU rather than hard-failing load.
    # On an A10G this usually keeps 100% of weights on GPU.
    llm_int8_enable_fp32_cpu_offload=True,
)

_model_cache = {}

def _load():
    if "model" not in _model_cache:
        tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(
            MODEL_ID,
            trust_remote_code=True,
            token=HF_TOKEN,
            cache_dir=os.environ["HF_HUB_CACHE"],
        )
        if tok.pad_token is None:
            tok.pad_token = tok.eos_token

        if torch.cuda.is_available():
            torch.cuda.empty_cache()

        mod = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
            MODEL_ID,
            trust_remote_code=True,
            token=HF_TOKEN,
            quantization_config=BNB,
            device_map="auto",
            # Calm the MoE memory estimator on A10G 24 GB
            max_memory={0: "22GiB", "cpu": "200GiB"},
            cache_dir=os.environ["HF_HUB_CACHE"],
            low_cpu_mem_usage=True,
        )
        _model_cache["model"] = mod
        _model_cache["tokenizer"] = tok
